rejected_attempts: Early L24 oracle setup incorrectly used unsupported fine geometry/height IDs; corrected fixtures retain L22 geometry and request fine material IDs. No production coordinate defect was demonstrated.
Initial Clippy gate rejected excess precision in a float literal; corrected before pinned checks.
limits: Reference parity and blind preference remain unaccepted. The local reference is an AI concept, not a photometric or botanical oracle.

Static 1280x720, EV12.10, 4x MSAA, TAA off, local RT, simulation time and step zero. 40s prestream, 30 warmup, 16 measured frames. Soil diagnostic disables canopy/understory identically in both versions; it is not the reference composition.
GPU runs were serial. Baseline standing capture overlapped CPU compilation; wall/CPU timings are not controlled. No isolated speedup or interactive-performance claim.
CBT/AS update work remains in measured frames. Identical frame count does not establish converged topology or equal material residency.
Geometry follows the shared render-only soil, not authoritative collision. Sampled leaf corner/fold clearance is not exact continuous contact or nonintersection against final CBT triangles.

Sweep runs exercise moving camera/streaming/CBT/RT paths, but only final images and per-frame timings are recorded; no full image sequence or temporal-stability acceptance. No new GI, canopy transport, rain/hydrology, GPU passes, other-platform or remote CI validation.
Full-scene source/admission and fixed-camera metadata are checked, but asynchronous material/height residency can differ. Blind pairs are unvoted and can be invalidated by confounds.
Reported level histogram equality does not establish resident page identity equality; pairs with different reported levels are invalid for isolated source-detail preference.
RT record counts include padded terrain capacity, not live primary triangles or ray intersections; AS bytes are planning estimates, not measured driver VRAM.
